Paste a filled `templates/STAGE_FEEDBACK.md` below, or link to it in your fork.

Maintainer triage (filled by maintainer):

- [ ] Each item classified: step change / contract change / stage change
- [ ] Step IDs assigned
- [ ] Applied or added to the capability-map backlog with priority
- [ ] `REVISIONS.md` updated for this stage
- [ ] Cascade check run if any *Provides* changed
